info.title: Clinic Management API
info.description: Manages clinics, providers, patients, allergies and appointments. Send a bearer token for anything that is not public. Errors are application/problem+json: 400 for validation failures, 403 when the signed-in user may not act on the resource, 404 for unknown resources and 409 for conflicts with the current state. A missing token (401) or a missing permission (403) rejected before the endpoint runs has an empty body.

get.description: Signed-in users. Searches by name, email, specialty and address, case-insensitively. q is required, trimmed, and at least 2 characters. limit is 1 to 20 (default 5) and caps each list. Patients are limited to those the caller treats as theirs: all for administrators; for a verified doctor, patients with an appointment with them; for a clinic administrator, patients with an appointment at a clinic they administer; empty for anyone else. Providers are verified only unless the caller is an administrator. Clinics are visible to all. Each list is ordered by name. Returns 400 for an invalid q or limit.

Administrators only. Every role granted through UserRoles, with the user it belongs to and who granted it (grantedByUserId is null for grants made by configuration or migration). Roles derived from data (patient, doctor, clinicadmin) are not listed.
Administrators only. Returns every patient, unpaged. Each item carries allergyCount (the number of recorded allergies) and highestSeverity (MILD, MODERATE or SEVERE, null when there are none).

post.description: Administrators only. Creates a patient not linked to any identity; signed-in users create their own with POST /api/me/patient. The id in the body is ignored. firstName, lastName, dateOfBirth (not in the future), phoneNumber and a valid email are required.

get.description: Administrators only. Searches patient names, email, and phone number, and returns a page (page from 1, pageSize 1 to 100, default 20). Each item carries allergyCount (the number of recorded allergies) and highestSeverity (MILD, MODERATE or SEVERE, null when there are none).
Visible to administrators and the patient themself; other callers get 403.

put.description: Only the patient themself; other callers, administrators included, get 403. The id in the route wins over any id in the body. Fields are validated as on create.

delete.description: Administrators only. Returns 409 while the patient has recorded allergies or appointments.

get.description: Returns the patient, their allergies, last and next visit (ignoring declined and cancelled appointments), appointment counts by status, and the three most recent visits. Visible to administrators, the patient, a clinic administrator of a clinic where the patient has an appointment (sees appointments at that clinic only), and a verified doctor with an appointment with the patient (sees their own appointments only). Other callers get 403, including for unknown ids; administrators get 404 for an unknown id.
Returns every appointment of the patient, unpaged. Visible to administrators and the patient themself; other callers get 403.
Returns every allergy recorded for the patient, with severity and notes. Visible to administrators and the patient themself; other callers get 403.

post.description: Only the patient themself; other callers, administrators included, get 403. Records allergyId with a severity (see GET /api/allergy-severities) and optional notes; if it is already recorded, its severity and notes are replaced. The body of the 201 is { allergyId }. Returns 404 for an unknown patient or allergy type.

get.description: Searches the patient's recorded allergies and returns a page (page from 1, pageSize 1 to 100, default 20). Visible to administrators and the patient themself; other callers get 403.

get.summary: List allergy types a patient can still record
get.description: Returns a page of allergy types not yet recorded for the patient, for an allergy picker. Pass selectedAllergyId when editing an existing allergy so that it stays in the options. Visible to administrators and the patient themself; other callers get 403.

put.description: Only the patient themself; other callers, administrators included, get 403. Replaces the severity and notes. allergyId in the body must match the route, otherwise 400.

delete.description: Only the patient themself; other callers, administrators included, get 403. Returns 404 when the allergy is not recorded for the patient.

get.description: Returns the token subject, display name, roles, the clinics the caller administers, and the linked patient and provider, or nulls when none exist. provider.clinicId is the provider's clinic, or null while the provider has none.

Returns one section per role the caller holds: admin (platform counts), clinicAdmin (counts for the caller's clinics), doctor (today, this week in UTC, the next appointment, and pendingRequestCount: REQUESTED appointments starting now or later), and patient (next appointment, upcoming count, and recentDecisions: up to five CONFIRMED or DECLINED appointments, newest decision first). Sections for roles the caller does not hold are null.

post.summary: Create the signed-in user's patient profile
post.description: Creates a patient linked to the caller's identity; the id in the body is ignored. firstName, lastName, dateOfBirth, phoneNumber and a valid email are required. Returns 409 when the identity already has a patient.

get.description: Administrators only. Returns every appointment, unpaged. Use GET /api/appointments/search for paged, filtered lists.

post.description: Patients only. Books a REQUESTED appointment for the signed-in patient; id and patientId in the body are ignored. appointmentDateTime must be in the future, and the appointment must start at or after clinic opening and end by closing. Returns 404 for an unknown provider, and 409 when the provider is not verified or already has an appointment within one appointment duration of the requested time.

get.description: Filters appointments by text, date range (from < to when both are given), clinic, provider, providerIds (repeatable, up to 100), status, or patient, and returns a page (page from 1, pageSize 1 to 100, default 20). Patients see only their own appointments and providers only their own; clinic administrators are limited to their clinic. Each item includes the patient's allergy summary (patientAllergyCount and patientHighestAllergySeverity, null when none) and timestamps: createdAtUtc is when the appointment was booked, and statusChangedAtUtc is when its status last changed (equal to createdAtUtc if it never has).
Visible to administrators, the appointment's patient and provider, and administrators of the provider's clinic; other callers get 403.

put.description: Administrators only. Replaces the patient, provider, time and reason. The new time follows the same rules as booking, and moving the appointment to another time or provider returns 409 when it would overlap another appointment.

delete.description: Administrators only. Removes the appointment permanently. To end an appointment while keeping its history, cancel it instead.

get.summary: Get the patient of an appointment
get.description: Visible to administrators, the appointment's patient and provider, and administrators of the provider's clinic; other callers get 403.

get.summary: Get the provider of an appointment
get.description: Visible to administrators, the appointment's patient and provider, and administrators of the provider's clinic; other callers get 403.

get.summary: Get the clinic of an appointment
get.description: Returns the clinic of the appointment's provider. Visible to administrators, the appointment's patient and provider, and administrators of the provider's clinic; other callers get 403.

post.description: Only the appointment's own verified provider. Moves REQUESTED to CONFIRMED. Returns 409 from any other status, or when the appointment changed concurrently.
Only the appointment's own verified provider. Moves REQUESTED to DECLINED. Returns 409 from any other status, or when the appointment changed concurrently.
Only the appointment's patient or provider; anyone else gets 403. Moves REQUESTED or CONFIRMED to CANCELLED. Returns 409 from any other status, or when the appointment changed concurrently.
Only the appointment's own verified provider. Moves CONFIRMED to COMPLETED. Returns 409 from any other status, or when the appointment changed concurrently.

get.description: Signed-in users. Returns every allergy type. Each item carries patientCount, the number of patients with that allergy recorded.

post.description: Administrators only. The id in the body is ignored; a new one is generated and returned. name is required.

get.description: Signed-in users. Searches allergy type names and returns a page (page from 1, pageSize 1 to 100, default 20). Each item carries patientCount, the number of patients with that allergy recorded.
Signed-in users. Returns one allergy type with patientCount, the number of patients with that allergy recorded.

put.description: Administrators only. The id in the route wins over any id in the body. name is required.

delete.description: Administrators only. Returns 409 while any patient has this allergy recorded.

get.summary: List patients with an allergy type (admin)
get.description: Administrators only. Returns every patient who has this allergy recorded.

Signed-in users. Searches clinic names, addresses, and phone numbers, and returns a page (page from 1, pageSize 1 to 100, default 20). Each item includes providerCount, the number of verified providers at the clinic.
Signed-in users. Returns the clinic's contact details.

put.description: Administrators only. The id in the route wins over any id in the body. name is required.

get.description: Signed-in users. Returns the clinic, providerCount (verified providers), todayAppointmentCount (UTC day, declined and cancelled excluded), topSpecialties (up to 3 by verified provider count, ties alphabetical) and up to 5 verified providers ordered by last and first name.
Signed-in users. Administrators and administrators of this clinic get every provider at the clinic, whatever their verification status; everyone else gets verified providers only.
Administrators and administrators of this clinic; other callers get 403. Returns every appointment with a provider at the clinic, unpaged.

post.description: Administrators only. The id in the body is ignored; a new one is generated and returned. name is required.

get.description: Every clinic (id, name, address, phoneNumber), each with providerCount: the number of verified providers at the clinic. Public while PublicAccess:Doctors is true (the default), for the doctor directory; otherwise signed-in users only.

post.description: Administrators only. Makes the identity subject an administrator of the clinic and returns the new assignment's id. The person does not need to have signed in yet. Returns 409 when they already administer the clinic.

get.description: Public. Searches providers by name, specialty, and clinic, optionally within clinicId, and returns a page (page from 1, pageSize 1 to 100, default 20). Anonymous and non-administrator callers only receive verified providers; administrators may also filter by verificationStatus to see unverified ones.
Public. Lists verified providers only, optionally searched and limited to clinicId, as a page (page from 1, pageSize 1 to 100, default 20).
Public. Returns the provider's profile, including its verification status.

put.description: Administrators, or the provider themself; other callers get 403. Providers cannot move themselves to another clinic (403). The id in the route wins over any id in the body. Returns 404 for an unknown provider or clinic.

delete.description: Administrators only. Returns 409 while the provider has any appointments.

get.description: Public. Returns 404 for an unknown provider, or one without a clinic.

get.summary: Get a bookable provider's summary and next free slot
get.description: Public, with no patient data. Returns the provider, its clinic, nextAvailableStart and todayAppointmentCount. nextAvailableStart is the earliest slot at or after now within the next 14 UTC days, or null if none is free. Slots start at clinic opening plus multiples of the appointment duration and must end by closing (both inclusive). A slot conflicts with a REQUESTED or CONFIRMED appointment that starts strictly within one duration of it. todayAppointmentCount covers the UTC calendar day and excludes declined and cancelled appointments. Returns 404 for an unknown provider, or one that is not verified.

get.summary: Get a provider's booked start times for a day
get.description: Public, with no patient data. date is a UTC calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD form. Returns the start times of the provider's REQUESTED and CONFIRMED appointments on that date, plus the appointment duration. A booking at time T conflicts when an active appointment starts strictly after T minus the duration and strictly before T plus the duration. Returns 404 for an unknown provider, or one that is not verified.
Administrators only. Returns every provider, whatever their verification status, unpaged.

post.description: Administrators only. Creates a provider not linked to any identity; doctors sign up with POST /api/providers/register. The id in the body is ignored. firstName, lastName, specialty and clinicId are required. Returns 404 when the clinic does not exist.

get.summary: Get a provider's appointments in a date range (provider)
get.description: Only the provider themself, once verified. Appointments starting in [from, to), at most 62 days, ordered by time. Declined and cancelled appointments are left out unless includeInactive is true.
Returns every appointment of the provider, unpaged. Visible to administrators, the provider themself, and administrators of the provider's clinic; other callers get 403.

Patients with at least one appointment with the provider, paged and optionally searched by patient name (search). Each row has the latest past and earliest upcoming visit relative to now, ignoring declined and cancelled appointments. Visible to administrators, the provider themself, and administrators of the provider's clinic; other callers get 403.

post.description: Signed-in users. Creates a provider at the given clinic with PENDING verification, linked to the signed-in identity. They stay out of the directory until an admin verifies them. firstName, lastName, specialty and clinicId are required. Returns 404 when the clinic does not exist and 409 when the identity already has a provider.

Administrators, and administrators of the provider's clinic; other callers get 403. Moves a PENDING or REJECTED provider to VERIFIED, which lists them in the directory and lets patients book them. Returns 409 when the provider is already verified or changed concurrently.
Administrators, and administrators of the provider's clinic; other callers get 403. Moves a PENDING provider to REJECTED. Returns 409 from any other status, or when the provider changed concurrently.

get.description: Public. Returns the severity values that can be recorded for a patient's allergy, mildest first.

get.summary: Get appointment duration and clinic hours
get.description: Public. Returns the configured appointment duration in minutes and the clinic opening and closing times, used to build booking slots.

get.summary: Get API status and resource totals
get.description: Public. Returns status "ok" and the totals of clinics, providers, patients, and appointments. For a plain liveness probe use GET /health.
Administrators only. Returns resource totals and the next five appointments with patient, provider, and clinic names. Signed-in users get their own role-aware dashboard from GET /api/me/dashboard.
Administrators only. assignedRoles are the roles granted explicitly; effectiveRoles adds the roles derived from the user's data. Returns 404 when no user has the identity subject.

put.summary: Assign a role to a user (admin)
put.description: Administrators only. Idempotent. Creates the user when they have not signed in yet. Only assignable roles are accepted (currently: admin); derived roles return 400.

delete.summary: Revoke a role from a user (admin)
delete.description: Administrators only. Idempotent. Only assignable roles are accepted (400 otherwise). Returns 404 when no user has the identity subject, and 409 when an administrator revokes their own admin role, or when the subject is listed in Authorization:AdminSubjects.
